title: Sagrada Familia
text:
Sagrada Familia is one place you really have to visit!
Paula, our tour guide was really good explaining all the details about the church.
She is highly recommended.
author: MaCristina_L

title: Wonderful Tour & Guide of the inside of the Basilica
text: We had a wonderful inside/outside tour of the Sagrada Família. Daria was a fantastic guide.  Our tour at 1:00 pm was perfect for seeing sunlight reflect throughout the basilica. Daria provided us with many interesting facts, answered all questions thoroughly and kept us moving efficiently. We highly recommend this tour!
author: mmk48

title: Fantastic
text: Maria was so passionate and enthusiastic!! I enjoyed the tour perfectly!!
author: Trek63636409209

title: Thank you!
text: Besides the fact that the Sagrada Familia is spectacular in itself, Erik the guide made the experience even better!
author: Mariapilar_C

title: Fab experience with a knowledgeable and friendly guide.
text: We loved our tour of Sargada Família. Daria (our guide) was at the meeting point early. We found the whole process straightforward, without delays and as per description. Daria is very knowledgeable, her English is clear to understand. We don’t have anything to compare to, but we feel we got a very good tour with plenty of interesting facts. The price was also cheaper than other guided tours. We were able to stay longer and walk around the place after the guided tour finished. This allowed us more time to take photos and absorb the beauty of the church.
author: Maps48221830217

title: Maria is the best!
text: Our tour was breathtaking and Maria was an awesome tour guide. It felt pleasant, easy, and fun. Great way to see Sagrada Família. 10/10 recommend.
author: Chas_W

title: Aweskme experience
text: Dania was an awesome guide. It’s really worth hearing the history behind the different facets of the church.
